Mohammad Shakirul Islam

IT support & data analyst in Victoria, BC, from the BC Ferries call centre to health data dashboards.

Now at BC Ferries · Open to IT support, data analysis and public service roles

  • 750+branches supported in IT support
  • 4peer-reviewed papers published

I hold an M.Sc. in Computer Science from the University of Victoria and a B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering. My research focused on information visualization, HCI, data science and information security. I have analyzed health data for the BC government, supported IT systems at a bank and a community association, and served customers at BC Ferries. I work in English and Bangla.

Projects

Selected work in data, research and technology.

  • YYJ Produce Prices Founder, web development, data collection, Python
    • Founded and built a price comparison site that helps Greater Victoria shoppers search a fresh produce item and compare prices across local stores, sorted by price.
    • Collects flyer and online catalog prices, normalizes them to $/kg or $/each, and clearly labels flyer versus regular prices.
    • Visit YYJ Produce Prices
  • Vital Events Data Visualization Tool R Shiny, data visualization, healthcare analytics, statistics
    • Built during my Ministry of Health co-op: an interactive R Shiny dashboard showing population health indicators across British Columbia.
    • Involved data processing, statistical analysis and interactive visualization, with features shaped by healthcare professionals to make complex data more accessible to decision-makers.
  • RaMSeS: Researcher's Management of Search and Storage Python, survey design, statistical analysis
    • Introduced the RaMSeS model of how academic document collections are managed while creating academic documents.
    • Designed and deployed a survey. Used Python for cluster and correlation analysis and significance testing.
    • Worked in a multidisciplinary team and documented design decisions and findings.
    • View on GitHub
  • InfoViz on Teachers in BC School Districts Information Visualization (CSC 511), Prof. Charles Perin
    • Dataset 1: BC Public School Teacher Statistics, 2013 to 2021 (employment category, headcount, predicted gender, average age, average salary, by year and district).
    • Dataset 2: Student enrolment and FTE by grade, including facility type and counts by indigeneity.
    • Target users: education policymakers analyzing teacher conditions across BC school districts.
  • Doctor Finder Mobile App Java, XML, Python, Retrofit, GitLab
    • Mobile app for locating doctors and scheduling appointments. Used Retrofit for REST requests and Postman for API testing.
    • View on GitLab
  • IFIC Bank: IT Support Portal Web development, IT support
    • Web portal helping end users resolve common tech issues, such as core-banking software setup and device configuration. ificbank.com.bd
  • Bayanno-Net: Bangla Handwritten Digit Recognition Deep learning, CNN, NumtaDB dataset
    • Proposed the CNN "BayannoNet" to recognize Bangla handwritten digits, using the NumtaDB dataset from the Bengali.ai community. Bangla is the 7th most popular language by first-language speakers.
    • Reached 97% accuracy with a very low cross-entropy rate. Paper
  • InceptB: Recognizing Traditional Bengali Games Computer vision, Inception V3
    • Applied computer vision to traditional Bangladeshi games by retraining the final layer of Google's Inception V3.
    • About 80% average accuracy across five traditional sports events. Paper
    • View on GitHub
  • Tomato Diseases Classification with Deep CNNs Deep learning, agriculture
    • Developed a 15-layer deep CNN that classifies five tomato diseases with high accuracy and low cross-entropy, for early disease detection. Paper
  • Shot-Net: Classifying Cricket Shots Deep learning, sports analytics
    • Developed a 13-layer CNN that classifies six cricket shots: Cut, Cover Drive, Straight Drive, Pull, Scoop and Leg Glance, with high accuracy and low cross-entropy. View on GitHub
